thesis: Real business, engine says no. Anant Raj is executing — FY26 revenue +22%, PAT +31%, near-zero net debt, zero pledge, and a credible data-centre pivot (28 MW operating, 357 MW planned). But two hard facts dominate: (1) the distress screen vetoes it on E1 — FY26 generated Rs 559 cr of profit and Rs -435 cr of operating cash, a 14.5% Sloan accrual gap that is exactly the paper-profits-without-cash signature the spec was built to catch; (2) the inverse-DCF anchor values the sustainable business at Rs 95/share vs Rs 578 market — the data-centre dream is priced for flawless execution. Not investable until cash converts and/or the price reaches the trigger ladder.
